crossRefs.note: But you, Yahweh, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.
By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.
We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.
Hezekiah also had said, “What is the sign that I will go up to Yahweh’s house?”

Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.
Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, Yahweh will be a light to me.
I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.

Increase my honor and comfort me again.

translations.web: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, Yahweh, have helped me, and comforted me.
translations.bsb: Show me a sign of Your goodness, that my enemies may see and be ashamed; for You, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.
translations.kjv: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, LORD, hast holpen me, and comforted
translations.asv: Show me a token for good, That they who hate me may see it, and be put to shame, Because thou, Jehovah, hast helped me, and comforted me. Psalm 87 A Psalm of the sons of Korah; a Song.
